cliContractSnippet.prepare: git forge pr prepare <n> --strategy merge|squash|rebase|ff  (flag REQUIRED); stdout: prepared PR #<n> for strategy <s> (candidate <hex>, generation <g>, base <hex>); pr show additive: prepared: strategy <s> result <hex>
cliContractSnippet.preparedCandidate: Appended pr.prepared event (generation, source_head, base_head=CURRENT base tip, strategy, result_commit, result_tree, merge_base) + CAS pin refs/forge/prs/<n>/result -> result_commit; re-prepare replaces (CAS old->new), no generation bump
cliContractSnippet.merge: With valid candidate: gate validate_prepared_candidate (generation==current, base_head==base tip, strategy match, decision+CI bound to candidate identity); finalize CASes base candidate.base_head -> candidate.result_commit, no rematerialization. Moved base w/o candidate: refuses naming pr prepare. Stale candidate (post-update): refuses re-prepare remedy. Unmoved + no candidate: legacy path preserved
cliContractSnippet.ciRun: With valid candidate: plan runs against candidate result commit; ci.check bound (strategy/result_commit/result_tree/generation/base_head). No candidate: legacy source-snapshot run
cliContractSnippet.review: pr review --approve records candidate binding (strategy/result_commit/result_tree) when a current candidate exists; gate requires decision identity == candidate identity

remainingRisks: Prepared candidate pin reuses refs/forge/prs/<n>/result; a stale isolated pinned ref with no pr.prepared event keeps the legacy create-time refusal (unchanged test).
race test cirace depends on temp-worktree liveness detection timing; bounded 30s deadline.
Result-bound CI on the candidate path: verify_result_ci is now unused (dead) — candidate CI runs against result commit directly.
